nina: rolling up comet-lite-7b int3 for quant pipeline. initial safety smoke shows refusal regression on multi-step jailbreaks, blocking for now.

carlos: numbers?

nina: fp16 baseline: jailb_success 3.8% | toxic_span 0.24%
int3 draft: jailb_success 7.9% | toxic_span 0.9% | soft_refusal_drop 3.1pp

kevin: did you use per-tensor or per-channel? which optimizer?

nina: per-tensor symmetric, no stoch. quant script: ./scripts/quantize.sh comet-lite-7b --bits 3 --mode symmetric --k=triton-fused

ops-bot: DEPLOY NOTE: run_id=run-1725559999-1 | probes=jailbreak_v2 + tox_v1 | samples=250 | jailb=7.9% | toxic=0.90% | artifacts=gs://redwood-models/comet-lite/int3/run-1725559999.tar.gz

carlos: try per-channel + stoch round. also test with temp=0.0 deterministic sampling to isolate sampling noise.

nina: i'll re-run with --mode per-channel --stoch=1 and post results. keeping rollout on hold. filing ticket: RDW-4573 quant safety threshold.

tara: can we add an automated gate in the CI that compares safety metrics vs baseline and fails if worst-case delta > 1.0pp jailb or >0.3pp toxic?

carlos: yes, add to rollout policy. also add quick fallback to fp16 if user traffic sees refusal token probability drop below 0.5x baseline.

nina: noted. re-run queued. will post new smoke thread when ready.
